## Play Console mapping

- App icon upload: `play-icon-512.png`
- Feature graphic upload: `feature-graphic.png`
- Phone screenshots upload: use the files in `phone-screenshots/` in numeric order

## Regenerating

Run:

```powershell
python .\scripts\generate_store_assets.py
```

The script overwrites the generated PNG files in this folder.
